name: exact-terminal-plus-last-tile-denial
methodology: 48 fresh matched scenario pairs/96games,24 per auctionmode, balanced6seats. Candidate wraps licensed terminalSafe=true with ExactTerminalStrategy(18ms,8000nodes), then LastTileDenial. Only final liquidation and penultimate bids differ: exact pre-purchase plan primes a monotone feasible floor, then denial bids entire balance. Control is current licensed terminalSafe=true. Three strong licensed clone/mutant and price-pressure/patient rosters. Seed/seat/opponent policies identical for both arms; prefix trace hashed and compared.
